texts.preamble: Mahender Kumar vs . State Of H.P. on 11 January, 2024 Mahender Kumar vs. State of H.P. . Cr.MP No.4970 of 2023 in Cr.MMO No.1313 of 2023 Order Reserved on: 02.01.2024 11.01.2024 rt The present petition has been filed for quashing of the complaint pending before the learned Additional Cjm, Palampur under Section 59(1) read with Section 3(1)(c)(zz), 26(2)(1)(ii) and 27(1)(c) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. 2. As per the complaint, the sample was taken on 23.05.2018 and the present petition has been filed after the lapse of five years.
